CREATE TABLE "public"."account" (
  "access_token" text,
  "expires_at" int4,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "id_token" text,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "providerAccountId" text NOT NULL,
  "refresh_token" text,
  "scope" text,
  "session_state" text,
  "token_type" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Account_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."address" (
  "addressLine1" text NOT NULL,
  "addressLine2" text,
  "city" text NOT NULL,
  "country" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "firstName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isDefault" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "lastName" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "postalCode" text NOT NULL,
  "state" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Address_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."adminAuditLog" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "details" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "resource" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "AdminAuditLog_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."blogPost" (
  "authorAvatar" text,
  "authorName" text,
  "authorRole" text,
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date" text NOT NULL,
  "excerpt" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "image" text NOT NULL,
  "published" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "readTime" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "BlogPost_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."candidatePhoto" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" bytea NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "mimeType" text NOT NULL,
  "size" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "CandidatePhoto_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."candidateProfile" (
  "availability" text,
  "certifications" jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "education" jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "expectedSalary" text,
  "experience" jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "githubUrl" text,
  "hasCustomPhoto" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "headline" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "languages" jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "linkedinUrl" text,
  "location" text,
  "portfolioUrl" text,
  "skills" jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "summary" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "CandidateProfile_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."contactInquiry" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "status" "InquiryStatus" DEFAULT 'NEW'::"InquiryStatus" NOT NULL,
  "subject" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "ContactInquiry_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."coupon" (
  "amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "discountType" "DiscountType" DEFAULT 'PERCENTAGE'::"DiscountType" NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "usageCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "usageLimit" int4,
  CONSTRAINT "Coupon_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."course" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "image" text,
  "price" numeric(10,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "status" "CourseStatus" DEFAULT 'DRAFT'::"CourseStatus" NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Course_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."enrollment" (
  "courseId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "progress" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Enrollment_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."externalArticle" (
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" text,
  "publishedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "source" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "ExternalArticle_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."lesson" (
  "content" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isFree" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "moduleId" text NOT NULL,
  "order" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "status" "CourseStatus" DEFAULT 'DRAFT'::"CourseStatus" NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "videoUrl" text,
  CONSTRAINT "Lesson_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."mediaAsset" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "format" text,
  "height" int4,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "publicId" text,
  "size" int4,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  "width" int4,
  CONSTRAINT "MediaAsset_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."module" (
  "courseId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "order" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "status" "CourseStatus" DEFAULT 'DRAFT'::"CourseStatus" NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Module_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order" (
  "addressId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'usd' NOT NULL,
  "customerEmail" text NOT NULL,
  "customerName" text,
  "customerPhone" text,
  "discount" numeric(10,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "orderNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "paymentStatus" "PaymentStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"PaymentStatus" NOT NULL,
  "shippingCost" numeric(10,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "status" "OrderStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"OrderStatus" NOT NULL,
  "stripePaymentId" text,
  "stripeSessionId" text,
  "subtotal" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "tax" numeric(10,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "total" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text,
  CONSTRAINT "Order_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."orderItem" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "orderId" text NOT NULL,
  "productId" text,
  "productName" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "totalPrice" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "OrderItem_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payment" (
  "amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'usd' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "orderId" text NOT NULL,
  "paymentMethod" text,
  "receiptUrl" text,
  "status" "PaymentStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"PaymentStatus" NOT NULL,
  "stripeChargeId" text,
  "stripePaymentIntentId" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Payment_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pendingEmailChange" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "newEmail" text NOT NULL,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "PendingEmailChange_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."product" (
  "category" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "discount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "featured" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "image" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "originalPrice" numeric(10,2),
  "price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "status" "ProductStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"ProductStatus" NOT NULL,
  "stock" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Product_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rateLimit" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "count" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "identifier" text NOT NULL,
  "resetAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "RateLimit_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."resume" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" bytea NOT NULL,
  "fileName" text NOT NULL,
  "fileSize" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "mimeType" text NOT NULL,
  "parsedData" jsonb,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Resume_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."session" (
  "expires" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "sessionToken" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Session_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."siteSetting" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "value" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "SiteSetting_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."testimonial" (
  "avatar" text NOT NULL,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isApproved" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "isFeatured" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "published" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "rating" int4 DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Testimonial_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "company" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "emailVerified" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "image" text,
  "isDisabled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "jobTitle" text,
  "name" text,
  "password" text,
  "pendingPhone" text,
  "phone" text,
  "role" "UserRole" DEFAULT 'CUSTOMER'::"UserRole" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "User_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userLessonProgress" (
  "completed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lessonId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "UserLessonProgress_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."verificationToken" (
  "expires" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "identifier" text NOT NULL,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("identifier", "token")
)
